1.

Grace is a glorious word, Blessed is he who rightly understands it; Through the heavens, over the earth Its mighty echo resounds.

2.

It was the God of all grace, Who in His counsel of love Gave the only Son for the world In ineffable grace.

3.

And this same rich grace Preserves us from falling, It shall ever follow us Along the entire way home.

4.

The grace that saved us Now nurtures and teaches us To gladly forsake the world’s vanity And live godly here.

5.

By grace alone we receive The crown God prepares, By grace we enter into heaven, Divine grace it is.
